What Finding and Exception are for:Finding is the working warehouse investigation for unsellable stock: assign units, ask the warehouse, collect evidence, record outcomes, adjust stock, escalate, and close. Exception is the underlying stock discrepancy/variance record that triggered or supports the investigation. The Finding should link to the Exception as a human-readable related discrepancy, not expose only a database number.
Live implementation before -&gt; after: implementation not live-verified -> fully hydrated Profile 82 UI + GET readback verified; unsellable watch unknown -> 86 SKU rows / 284 units; allocation unknown -> 1 assigned / 283 unassigned; findings unknown -> 1 open / 1 unresolved; UI KPI unchecked -> 283 / 1 / 1, reconciled to API.
Current live Finding:FND-20260805-00001 / related discrepancy EX-1; Karlmobel / AUTOMATIC-DUSTBIN-SILVER-40L / MYK; NOT_FOUND / OPEN; quantity/unresolved 1 / 1; first observed 2026-08-04 19:39 MYT; due 2026-08-05 17:57 MYT; review state about 7 days overdue / NOT_ESCALATED. Warehouse PIC, questions, response, evidence, owner name, resolution, and all outcome quantities remain blank/zero. Next action: Contact warehouse and verify stock.
Implementation assessment: The core workflow is implemented and usable: allocation, reason categories, Investigate/Response/Result/Escalate/Close stages, outcome quantities, and adjustment-first restoration/write-off controls are present. Close is exposed only from RESULT_RECORDED. It is acceptable for controlled UAT, but amendments are needed before relying on it as a strong operational control.
Recommended amendments and benefit:
  1. Show due date, overdue days, escalation, owner, latest update, and evidence state: makes aged cases visible and accountable.
  2. Add an SLA overdue queue with notifications/escalation: reduces missed warehouse follow-up.
  3. Rename Findings to Unsellable Investigations and technical Exception #1 to a human related-discrepancy reference: clearer for operators.
  4. Add search, shop/reason/status/overdue filters, sorting, and pagination: makes the 86-row queue manageable.
  5. Hide or relabel zero-available Create case as Assigned: prevents misleading duplicate-action prompts.
  6. Require evidence for response/result/close at client and server: prevents unsupported closure and improves auditability.
  7. Add version, idempotency, correlation, actor, and before/after history controls: prevents duplicate/conflicting writes and makes every change traceable.
  8. Use validated selectors and automatic links for outbound/exception relationships: reduces wrong-ID linkage.
Operational side effects: Profile 82 pre-existing Active -> Active; start/stop 0/0 -> 0/0; run-created targets 2 opened -> 2 closed; live case, stock, adjustment, customer, marketplace, Google, and employee-webapp writes each 0 -> 0.
